educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn basic skills for planning, designing, constructing, and maintaining underground infrastructure. (2) learn basic skills for analyzing changes in society, creating a desirable environment, and promoting sustainability.
advice: This is a project that relates to underground space engineering. books: Appropriate references are assigned based on students’ progress.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Students can fully explain reasonable construction and advanced maintenance techniques for underground structures. (2) Students can do experiments, analyses, and investigations fully by themselves. (3) Students can give presentations, fully report their results, and discuss their outcomes freely. (4) Students act in full accordance with engineering ethics.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Students can understand reasonable construction and advanced maintenance techniques for underground structures. (2) Students can perform experiments, analyses, and investigations with graduate students. (3) Students can present and report their results and discuss them. (4) Students act in accordance with engineering ethics.

lessons.content: 1) A research topic is set. 2) A literature survey is conducted. 3) Undergraduate students receive advice in seminars. 4) Presentations and papers are contributed to academic societies.
1) Research activities continue. 2) A bachelor's thesis is written, presented, and defended in an open hearing.
